name: night-signal

subject.name: Night Signal
subject.audience: Festival-goers on a phone, in the dark, in a crowd
subject.primaryJob: Find who plays where right now
sources: Stage lighting: colored washes and beams cutting through haze
LED walls and the timetable boards at each stage

principles: No ornament for its own sake: no squiggles, confetti or pastel play
Energy comes from color relationships, not decoration

territories.name: Stage at night
territories.description: Festival stages after dark: haze, colored washes, LED walls, point sources in a dark field.
territories.light: saturated washes and beams in darkness
territories.composition: big stacked time-and-stage rows readable at arm's length
territories.motion: pulses and quick settles, like a light cue

muse.name: Sonia Delaunay
muse.take: Simultaneous contrast: adjacent color fields that make each other vibrate, in rhythm
muse.leave: Her literal concentric discs and textile patterns

signature.reason: Delaunay's complementary color rhythms carry the stage energy, so the accents pair as complements instead of adding ornament

samples.confirmation: Saved. We'll ping you 10 minutes before.
samples.error: No signal here. Showing the last schedule we had.

avoid: Squiggles and confetti on pastel backgrounds
Small type that needs a steady hand to read

rationale.color.character.harmony: Complementary pairs (cobalt and orange) are Delaunay's simultaneous contrast.
rationale.form.scale: Large targets and type for a phone held in a moving crowd.
rationale.form.curvature: Round echoes Delaunay's circles without going to pill.
rationale.form.line: Hairlines separate surfaces in the dark, where shadows vanish.
rationale.form.elevation: Layered, not the territory's floating: shadows do not read on a dark field.
